description.value: Roll N Bowl is a Japanese-inspired restaurant on Yates Street in the heart of downtown Victoria, serving an extensive menu of sushi rolls, rice bowls, poke, and Asian fusion dishes. Online ordering with pickup from the 788 Yates St location is fully supported through their Square-powered website. Its central location in a dense commercial block makes it an easy refuelling stop for cyclists moving through downtown.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (23 spaces, covered) at 53m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rollnbowlvic.com is live and confirms Roll N Bowl is an active sushi and Asian-fusion restaurant at 788 Yates St, Victoria, with a full online ordering and pickup system powered by Square. Phone number (250) 886-1518 and address match OSM values; however, the website lists Monday as closed, which conflicts with the OSM opening_hours tag, indicating OSM hours are likely outdated. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, but the menu clearly shows multiple plant-based items and the pickup option is explicitly confirmed.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag likely outdated: website lists Monday as closed, which OSM hours do not reflect.
Website lists email rollnbowlvictoria@gmail.com not present in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Victoria confirmed by a live website with an active menu and online ordering system.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items including Edamame, Seaweed Salad, Avocado roll, Kappa (cucumber) roll, Yam Roll, Shiitake roll, Yam Tempura, and the Spring house roll (avo, cucumber, salad, mango)
